site_snapshot.basis: no governed Switzerland OpenStreetMap place-of-worship snapshot is included in this country data-map release
site_snapshot.notes: The Switzerland release exposes canton religion-area summaries only; place-density metrics remain null until a governed place layer is built.

source_datasets.name: Religionszugehörigkeit nach Grossregion und Kanton
source_datasets.citation: Federal Statistical Office, structural survey, religious affiliation by major region and canton, 2010-2024.
source_datasets.redistribution_limits: Raw source is not committed; commercial reuse requires permission from the data owner under OPEN-BY-ASK.
source_datasets.notes: This is a sample survey of the permanent resident population aged 15+ and includes confidence intervals by category in the workbook.

source_datasets.name: swissBOUNDARIES3D canton boundaries, 2026-01
source_datasets.redistribution_limits: Derived simplified GeoJSON is committed with attribution.
source_datasets.notes: The tlm_kantonsgebiet layer has 26 canton features.

indicators.label: Structural survey population estimate
indicators.description: Weighted sample-survey estimate for the permanent resident population aged 15+.
indicators.method: Read from the annual structural survey workbook's Total column by canton.
indicators.quality_notes: This denominator differs from the census population count and has survey uncertainty.

indicators.label: Structural survey religious-affiliation estimate
indicators.description: Estimated share with a religious affiliation, excluding Ohne Religionszugehörigkeit and Religionszugehörigkeit unbekannt when the unknown category is published for the canton.
indicators.method: 100 * (Total - Ohne Religionszugehörigkeit - Religionszugehörigkeit unbekannt) / Total when unknown affiliation is not suppressed.
indicators.quality_notes: Rows are flagged sample_survey_estimate. The source workbook publishes confidence intervals by category; the legacy area-summary row schema has no CI columns, and affiliation is null where unknown affiliation is suppressed.

indicators.label: Structural survey no-religion estimate
indicators.description: Estimated share reporting no religious affiliation.
indicators.quality_notes: The source workbook publishes confidence intervals for the no-religion estimate in every canton-year.

visual_layers.label: Structural survey religious-affiliation estimate
visual_layers.description: Sample-survey affiliation estimate by canton, aged 15+.
visual_layers.notes: Sample-survey construct only; not a census continuation.

visual_layers.label: Structural survey no-religion estimate
visual_layers.description: Sample-survey no-religion estimate by canton, aged 15+.
visual_layers.notes: The no-religion estimate is complete for every canton-year.
